title: Impersonal se: how people lived and travelled

sections.content: You know impersonal *se* from B1 Unit 6: *se* + a singular verb, with no noun, says what people in general do or did (*se trabaja mucho aquí*). It leaves out who is acting, which is useful for describing a way of life. Use it for how people lived, travelled and dealt with the state.

items.spanish: En las montañas se vivía casi sin contacto con el gobierno.
items.english: In the mountains people lived almost without contact with the government.

items.spanish: Con el ferrocarril se viajaba más rápido.
items.english: With the railway people travelled faster.

items.spanish: A veces se tardaba semanas en llegar a la ciudad.
items.english: Sometimes it took weeks to reach the city.

items.spanish: Ya no se podía vivir sin tratar con el Estado.
items.english: People could no longer live without dealing with the State.

sections.content: With no noun after it, the verb stays singular (*se viajaba*, *se tardaba*). When a noun follows, the verb agrees with it, as in the passive *se* you know: *se enviaban mensajes*. Do not use a plural verb for the impersonal: not *se vivían en las montañas*.
